videos.description: JaTarvious Whitlow escapes for a 54-yard run but fumbles at the 1-yard line but Anthony Schwartz is there for Auburn for a TD recovery.

videos.headline: Auburn blocks Ole Miss FG attempt
videos.description: Auburn's special teams come up big as they block Ole Miss' field goal attempt on the opening drive.

videos.headline: Auburn strikes first with TD throw
videos.description: Auburn's Jarrett Stidham finds a wide-open JaTarvious Whitlow for a 3-yard touchdown.

videos.headline: Auburn RB powers in for 1-yard TD
videos.description: Auburn's Malik Miller extends the lead over Ole Miss as he fights through the line for a 1-yard touchdown.

videos.headline: Ole Miss' Ta'amu finds WR for 12-yard TD
videos.description: Jordan Ta'amu throws to A.J. Brown who jukes defenders for a 12-yard Ole Miss touchdown.
